collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VI (101-120, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager lies awake wondering whether fish sleep, and goes down to the tide pools before dawn to find out.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been lying awake wondering whether fish sleep. They don't have eyelids. They're always moving. But they must get tired, surely? After a whole day of swimming? Before dawn, (subject) gets up, takes a torch and goes down to the tide pools to find out.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) crouches by a tide pool, very still. The little fish hang in the water, barely moving, tucked under ledges. Are they asleep? Are they just thinking? One of them drifts sideways and gives a small, startled twitch, exactly the way (subject) does when (subject.he/she) dozes off by the fire. (subject) decides that's a yes.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (friend) is not delighted to be woken. (friend.He/She) comes anyway, wrapped in a blanket and grumbling. They crouch over the pool together. "Are they asleep?" whispers (subject). "I was," whispers (friend). Then (friend.he/she) sees a fish slowly bump into a rock and drift away without noticing. They both have to cover their mouths so they don't laugh and wake it.
